text: maññeyya tammeti na maññeyya . sabbaṃ na maññeyya sabbasmiṃ na maññeyya sabbato na maññeyya sabbaṃ meti na maññeyya . so evaṃ amaññamāno na kiñci 1 loke upādiyati anupādiyaṃ na paritassati aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti . [121] ejā bhikkhave rogo ejā gaṇḍo ejā sallaṃ . tasmā tiha bhikkhave tathāgato anejo viharati vītasallo . tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya anejo vihareyyaṃ vītasalloti .
